cases.expected: Registration opens My Tasks for the new user.
cases.procedure: From Log in click Register, enter a unique username and valid password, then submit.

cases.expected: Incorrect credentials are rejected with a readable error.
cases.procedure: Log out, enter the registered username and a wrong password, then click Log in.

cases.expected: Valid credentials restore the session and open My Tasks.
cases.procedure: Enter the registered username and correct password and submit.

cases.expected: New task appears with its title, category and date.
cases.procedure: Click + New Task, fill title, description, Work and 2099-04-10, then click Create Task.

cases.expected: Edit form is prefilled and saves the updated title, category, date and description.
cases.procedure: Click Edit for Alpha planning, inspect prefill, replace all four fields and save, then reopen Edit.

cases.expected: Completion can be toggled on, off and on again.
cases.procedure: Activate the Alpha revised completion button three times and check each badge.

cases.expected: Title search matches a substring and gives a useful empty result.
cases.procedure: Create Beta errands under Personal. Search for revised, then for missing-title.

cases.expected: Category, open/done status and combined criteria select the expected tasks.
cases.procedure: Clear search, select Study then Open then Done. Reset category and select Open.

cases.expected: Dashboard counters match 2 total, 1 open and 1 recently completed. Tasks returns to the list.
cases.procedure: Click Dashboard, read all five counters, then use Tasks in the navigation.

cases.expected: Cancelling preserves the task and confirming removes it after reload.
cases.procedure: Click Delete for Beta errands, dismiss its dialog, then click Delete again and accept.

cases.expected: Logout opens Log in and a fresh dashboard request redirects there.
cases.procedure: Click Log out, then request /dashboard in the same browser context.

cases.expected: Task list and navigation fit the configured CSS viewport.
cases.procedure: Open a populated Tasks page, measure document width and compare actual layout viewport to configured width.
